minutes.headline: Selectmen found three liquor violations at JNM Sports Bar and set a 14-day suspension; old primary demolition ballot question approved.
minutes.summary: The Select Board held a liquor license violation hearing, approved several licenses, backed a new Comcast cable contract, and jointly appointed a school committee member. It went through the Town Meeting warrant articles, recommending the Brooks House sale 4-1 and holding several for Town Meeting. After long debate it voted to place a debt exclusion question for demolishing the old primary school on the annual ballot.

what_happened.line: The board found three violations against JNM Sports Bar at a liquor hearing; a suspension was set, but its vote is not audible in the recording.
The board placed a debt exclusion question for demolishing the old primary school on the annual ballot after long debate; the vote is not audible.
The board voted 4-1 to recommend the Brooks House article for Town Meeting.
The board approved the Comcast cable contract with one abstention.
The board appointed a school committee member and told the town manager to look into Flat Hill drainage records after a stormwater complaint.

why_it_matters: A debt exclusion lets the town borrow outside the tax limit, so if voters approve the old primary demolition question, property tax bills would rise to repay it.
The Town Meeting warrant recommendations, including Brooks House, show where the board stands before residents vote on those articles.
The new cable contract changes what the town receives from Comcast, and the Flat Hill flooding review could lead to drainage work.
